Insublend SDS September 2023 (R-NANOVIA-INSUBLEND-SDS-202309-afadf4eb9e7c) §1.2 prohibits food/drinking-fluid contact and mouth-contact toys, while §7.2 says the product is approved for food contact. Both English and French repeat this internal disagreement (Q05379/Q05380). Retain both statements; vendor clarification and applicable certificate/test scope are needed. No food-contact suitability or approval is established.

products.name: Nanovia Insublend
products.composition: Polyphenylene ether resin. Mixture of poly(2,6-dimethyl-1,4-phenyleneoxide), polystyrene and elastomer. SDS p. 1 §3.2: merged 65–90% aggregate for PPO, polystyrene and poly(butadiene-styrene); individual PPE:PS ratio not published. Aromatic phosphate ester 5–22%, additives 0.1–5%, carbon black 0–2%. Source R-NANOVIA-INSUBLEND-SDS-202309-afadf4eb9e7c; no shared formulation with another PPE-PS grade.

items.text: Restriction of use: Do not use INSUBLEND for medical containers, parts of in-vivo or which contact with mucosa, body fluid, blood. Equipments and parts for food contact and drinking fluids. Toys which contact with mouth.

items.conditions: Unresolved internal contradiction: section 1.2 prohibits food/drinking-fluid contact and mouth-contact toys. Both English and French repeat the disagreement. No verified certificate or food-contact qualification; do not use this isolated claim for suitability.

items.text: Ensure adequate ventilated place. Avoid fumes and dust.
